commit.message:
This PR submits the prediction results of CleanTS. (#103)

CleanTS is based on a standard encoder-only Transformer architecture
without any modifications to the model structure. Instead, it focuses on
the potential of data-centric optimization.

The highlights of our data governance include:

- Zero Synthetic Data: The model is trained exclusively on authentic,
real-world data, avoiding any synthetically generated samples.

- Publicly Sourced & Cleaned: All training and evaluation were conducted
on publicly available datasets. We achieved competitive performance
solely through systematic data cleaning processes rather than
architectural changes.

- Strict Data Separation: We ensure that no data from the GiftEval test
set was involved in the training process, maintaining the integrity of
the evaluation.

As a simple yet effective pre-trained baseline, we hope CleanTS provides
a solid foundation and valuable insights for the community.

---------

Co-authored-by: Taha Aksu <tahaaksu01@gmail.com>
